title: Privacy Policy
intro: How Epsilon Publishing Group handles the personal data you share with us through this website.
body:
## Who we are

Epsilon Publishing Group ("we", "us") is responsible for the personal data collected through epsilonpublishinggroup.com. Our office is at Gümüşsuyu Mahallesi, Osmanlı Sokak No:18/4, Beyoğlu, Istanbul, Türkiye. For any question or request about your personal data, email [pelin@epsilonyayingrubu.com](mailto:pelin@epsilonyayingrubu.com).

We process personal data in line with the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK) and, where it applies, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

## What we collect and why

**Rights enquiries.** When you use our contact form, we receive your name, email address and message, and your company, country and subject if you give them. We use them to answer your enquiry and to follow up on any rights discussion that results. The form is processed by FormSubmit, a third-party form service, which forwards your message to us by email. Before sending, FormSubmit may ask you to complete a short verification on its own page.

**Newsletter.** When you subscribe, we receive your email address, also through FormSubmit. We use it only to send you our newsletter about new titles, rights news and fair dates, which we manage with the email marketing service Setrow. Every newsletter has a link to unsubscribe, and you can also email us at any time.

**Emails you send us.** If you write to us directly, we use your message and contact details to reply.

**Website usage.** We use Cloudflare Web Analytics to count visits. It does not use cookies and does not follow you across websites; it gives us overall figures such as page views and the countries visitors come from.

We do not sell your personal data, and we do not use it for automated decision-making.

## Cookies and technical data

This website does not set cookies. Our fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, so your browser connects to Google's servers and shares your IP address with Google. The site is hosted on GitHub Pages; like any web host, GitHub records technical information such as IP addresses in its server logs for security purposes.

## Legal basis

We handle your enquiry and contact details because this is necessary to take steps at your request before a possible agreement, and for our legitimate interest in managing our rights business. We send the newsletter with your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.

## Who receives your data

We share your data only with our staff who handle your enquiry and with the service providers named above (FormSubmit, Setrow, Cloudflare, Google and GitHub), which process it on our behalf or to run this website. Some of these providers process data outside Türkiye, including in the United States.

## How long we keep it

- Enquiries and related correspondence: for as long as needed to handle your enquiry and any business relationship that follows, and afterwards for the periods the law requires.
- Newsletter: until you unsubscribe.

## Your rights

Under Article 11 of KVKK, and the GDPR where it applies, you can ask whether we process your personal data, request access to it, ask us to correct or delete it, object to its processing and ask who it has been shared with. Email [pelin@epsilonyayingrubu.com](mailto:pelin@epsilonyayingrubu.com) and we will reply within 30 days. You can also complain to the Turkish Personal Data Protection Authority or, in the EU, to your local data protection authority.

## Links to other websites

Our website links to other sites, such as Instagram, LinkedIn and the websites of book fairs. Their own privacy policies apply when you visit them.

## Changes to this policy

We may update this policy. The date at the top shows when it last changed.
seo_description: How Epsilon Publishing Group handles personal data from rights enquiries, newsletter sign-ups and visits to this website, and your rights.
